_what: The one version store for every versioned thing kept in a person's saved records (src/native-workspace-records.mjs, collections read by src/workspace-revision-selection.mjs). Each `records` row is an owner type: the record address (or address prefix) it versions, `owner_type` (the name a reader sees), and `collection`: the members versioned one by one ({ path, identity_field }, path [] when the record itself is the list) or { whole: <member id> } when the whole record is one member. `kinds` is per-kind retention: `keep` versions of that kind per member (null: never pruned by count and never evicted for room; a version of that kind is refused when there is no room). A row may override a kind's keep with `retention`. `asked: true` kinds are the ones a person or AI may keep a version as on request (POST /records/revisions/keep); the others are kept by the store itself. `writer_kinds` names the kind a write is kept as from the road it came by (src/write-via.mjs `road`), and `turn: true` keeps what that one admitted command changed as a turn that can be put back together (`turns_kept` newest turns). Every other write is `default_kind`. A new owner type, kind or road is one row here.
